messages.subject: Harborlight mark-up — points for decision
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Sofia,

My note on the Denham Lewis mark-up is attached. The headline is the liability cap — they've gone to 200% and carved out data protection entirely. My recommendation is to land at 150% of trailing 12-month fees and resist the carve-out. On payment, I'd hold net 30. On the SLA, Operations have confirmed 99.7% is sustainable but 99.9% is not, so we should offer 99.7% with an enhanced service-credit table.

Can you confirm the cap and payment positions and I'll prepare v3?

Kind regards,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100 | whitfieldcarter.com

Agreed on all three. 150% cap is acceptable to the board; resist the data-protection carve-out but we can live with a separate higher sub-limit for data breaches if they insist. Hold net 30. 99.7% on the SLA is fine — Theo's team confirmed the same number to me. Please prepare v3.
